high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the Tamil film "Golive," starring Superstar Rajinikanth. The poster highlights the film's record-breaking box office performance, stating that it has achieved the highest worldwide gross collection in the history of Tamil cinema, with earnings exceeding 404 crores (Indian Rupees) within just four days. The central figure in the poster is Rajinikanth, who is depicted in a dynamic pose, holding a red scarf around his neck. He is dressed casually in a blue shirt and jeans, exuding an energetic and charismatic vibe.
